# Reference

Every builtin element, prop, service, type, function and token, with the doc it carries in the schema (the same text an editor's hover shows). The language's rules are in [`docs/spec.md`](../spec.md) and its syntax in [`docs/grammar.md`](../grammar.md); the [guide](../guide/README.md) teaches it. Under the compatibility policy (spec.md, section 14) every entry here is only ever added to in 1.x, never removed or changed in meaning.

These pages are generated by `strand-dev reference` from the builtin schema (`crates/strand-compiler/src/schema/builtin.schema`) and the builtin services' schemas (`crates/strand-services-schema/src/*.schema`). Edit those, then run `strand-dev reference` from the repository's root; a test fails while the pages are out of date. A plugin's services are not listed: they are in its own schema files.

| Page | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| [elements.md](elements.md) | 41 elements and 2 prop groups, with their props, events and scope names |
| [services.md](services.md) | 24 services, with their fields, methods, actions and events |
| [types.md](types.md) | 28 records, 31 enums, 1 alias and 10 opaque types |
| [functions.md](functions.md) | 40 functions, 1 value and 19 methods on builtin types |
| [tokens.md](tokens.md) | 62 palette roles and 25 base tokens |
